_README: Waypoint pin corrections — the 6 routes the 2026-08-13 pin triage found SAFELY fixable.
Evidence, and why ~130 other findings are excluded: research-data/WAYPOINT-PIN-TRIAGE-2026-08-13.md
Every pin here is re-homed from peer rows on the same peak that agree with each other, verified
at generation time rather than taken from the report. Pins that are provably wrong but have no
agreeing peer are NOT here — they need a survey, and inventing a coordinate for a feature like a
bergschrund or a col is worse than leaving a known-bad pin visible.

wa_mount_rainier_liberty_ridge._why: The Liberty Cap pin sits 2,103 m from where five peer rows place it identically.

wa_primus_peak_south_ridge._why: The trailhead pin is named 'Eldorado Creek trailhead' and sits 21.5 km from where two peers start AND from this route's own gpx first point (Thunder Creek TH). The route's own track agreeing with the peers against its own pin is what makes this decisive.

waypoints.name: Eldorado Creek trailhead (Cascade River Road mile 20)
waypoints.note: South end of Colonial Creek Campground on Hwy 20; an alternate southern approach via Eldorado Creek and the Eldorado ice cap is also used for this side.

waypoints.name: Primus Peak
waypoints.note: South side/McAllister Glacier aspect reached by continuing past Lucky Pass or via the Eldorado ice cap traverse; glacier travel gear required.

wa_mount_rainier_edmunds_headwall._why: 640 m off, and its elev of 2900 is wrong for Mowich Lake (4,929 ft) — the coordinate and the elevation are wrong together, which is why one peer is enough here: the peer corroborates BOTH.

waypoints.name: Mowich Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: Long approach (~10+ mi) via Westside Rd, South Puyallup Trail, Wonderland Trail to St. Andrews Park, then Puyallup Cleaver

waypoints.name: Liberty Cap (route tops out here, below/at the NW rim)

wa_prusik_peak_solid_gold._why: The Stuart Lake trailhead pin is 597 m from where seven peer rows agree.

wa_prusik_peak_west_ridge._why: The row carries TWO Aasgard Pass pins 890 m apart. This drops the outlier rather than moving it — a duplicate is not a displaced pin, and keeping both would leave the list with a pin that has no journey.

waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead (Trail #1599)
waypoints.note: Also reachable via the Stuart Lake/Colchuck Lake Trailhead (~47.528,-120.820) over Aasgard Pass — a genuinely different, commonly-used alternate approach — but this route's own recorded GPS track starts at Snow Lakes TH, not Stuart Lake TH.
